name: How much does water service line replacement cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does water service line replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of water service line replacement varies significantly based on several factors, including the length of the line, its depth, the chosen pipe material (e.g., copper, PEX), and the complexity of the excavation required. Factors like concrete removal, landscaping restoration, and the need for specialized equipment can also impact the final price. It's best to get a detailed on-site estimate to understand the specific costs for your property. CG Plumbing Solutions provides transparent quotes after a thorough assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on pipe length, depth, material, and excavation complexity, requiring an on-site estimate for accurate pricing.
